matches.rationale: No claim or employment history shows enterprise IT infrastructure experience. The candidate's roles are in sales, business development, and finance, with no technical infrastructure work.

No claim or role shows managing or leading a technical team. The candidate has leadership titles (Director, COO) but none in a technical context, and no evidence of managing engineers or technical staff.
No claim mentions Active Directory administration or design. The candidate's technical claims are limited to sales of IaaS/SaaS and VoIP, not hands-on AD work.
No claim or role shows network administration (routing, switching, firewalls). The candidate sold telephony and hardware but did not administer networks.
No claim mentions information security risk management or audit. The candidate's background is in sales and finance, not security.
No claim or role shows planning or executing infrastructure upgrade projects. The candidate's project work is in sales and business development, not IT infrastructure.
No education section is provided, and no claim evidences a technical degree or equivalent demonstrable technical experience. The candidate's experience is non-technical.
No claim or document mentions right to work in Germany. Absent any mention, basis is unstated.
No claim mentions any security certification (CISSP, CISM, Security+).
No claim or role shows experience in logistics, transport, or manufacturing. The candidate's roles are in sales, finance, and government software.
No claim mentions VMware, Hyper-V, or any virtualisation technology.
No claim mentions disaster recovery or business continuity planning.
No claim mentions cloud migration or Azure/AWS. The candidate sold IaaS but did not perform or plan cloud migrations.
No claim mentions German language skills.
No claim addresses availability to work three days a week in Berlin.
No claim shows mentoring or managing junior engineers. The candidate's leadership is in sales, not technical mentoring.
No claim addresses start date or availability within six weeks.

style.caveat: Writing style alone is never evidence. Non-native English phrasing and assistive writing tools are known false-positive triggers - a published study found a 61% false-positive rate for non-native writers. Treat this as a prompt to read the document, never as a finding.
